architecture.summary: Free access creates the Thermus account first and refuses an existing account. Step 1 of GET /signup is Create account: the new GET /signup/start starts the AuthKit sign-in at its sign-up screen (screen_hint=sign-up) through the session controls and returns to /signup. The WorkOS signup adapter reads one membership record of the user in any status: a record without product access is the new outcome existing-account, which GET /signup shows as the notice You already have a Thermus account and POST /signup refuses with 403; current product access keeps Continue. Public contracts change (contract, internalInterface): BrowserSessionControls.startSignIn takes BrowserSignInRequest with the screen hint, SignupActivation gains existing-account, and the web signup route uses startSignIn of identity. The AuthKit integration changes (external): the authorize URL carries the sign-up screen hint, and the adapter makes a new user-scoped membership read. Team flag sensitiveBehavior: the admission rule of organization creation and the security file workos-signup.ts change; every existing guard stays. No container, component, dependency, or deployment change.
